notes.title: Update: v1.3.2 Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35784913/55c70610203f4d6762e112cd9a5e3aee37b8b4ec.gif[/img]

It's been a while since the last update! Here's what's been changed:
[list]
[*] Blobert is now stronger. Enemies caught within his landing-radius get destroyed.
[*] Coin screen wrapping fix (God of Wealth)
[*] Level selection UI fix
[/list]

[b]For mac users, if you're facing issues running the game after the update, please uninstall and reinstall the game.[/b]

Happy scrambling and don't forget to leave a review if you haven't already! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3 - More tiny fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35784913/42e85d5bc64148346850436951ee2640fbb5e40d.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed occasional crash bug
[*]Hold ESC/B-button to skip credit screen
[*]Space-key now works as a confirm button
[*]Default volume now at 50% (this update will not affect those who's already started the game).
[/list]

notes.title: Less than 1 day till release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35784913/d8530258cc7ea90f57b2e167fcdefe2dde9fb0a5.gif[/img]

[b]Serious Scramblers[/b] goes live in less than 24 hours! Dodge fire orbs, evade spikes, and defeat the horror that lies in the depths below! Wishlist the game now and be notified when it launches!
